name: Gebhard et al. 2019 fully convolutional detector
source: Paper Sec. IV A (Model architecture) and Fig. 3 (schematic of the dilated stack): input 1x1 convolution, 12 dilated convolution blocks, output 1x1 convolution, sigmoid.
unknowns: Padding is not stated; the text says the output is n - r + 1 steps long for an n-step input (valid convolutions, receptive field about 2 s).
The ensemble of overlapping sub-networks mentioned in the thesis is not described in this section.

nodes.label: Whitened strain, H1 and L1 as 2 channels
